parameters.name: Cron
parameters.description: The cron expression that is used to specify the start time of the upgrade.

parameters.name: CronDay
parameters.description:
The day of a week on which you want to perform the upgrade. Valid values:

*   **MON**
*   **TUE**
*   **WED**
*   **THU**
*   **FRI**
*   **SAT**
*   **SUN**

parameters.name: CronType
parameters.description:
The type of the upgrade cycle. Valid values:

*   **day**: every day
*   **week**: every week

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The duration of the upgrade. Unit: hours.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-publish-cron --cron 0_5_10_0_0_0 --duration 24 --cron-type day --cron-day SUN --cron-time 1657407600000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpdatePublishCron --region cn-hangzhou --CronDay SUN --Duration 24 --CronType day --Cron 0_5_10_0_0_0 --CronTime 1657407600000
